content:
elena: Quick heads-up: GA for the Hosted opt-in low-latency streaming path next Tue 10:00 PT. Endpoint will be POST /v2/low-latency/stream and opt-in via header X-Redwood-LowLatency: 1. Canary tonight: 5% traffic in us-west-2; expand if healthy. Tool-call defaults tightened to 15/min per-tool per-key on Hosted. Docs, support templates, and monitoring need final signoff.

matt: I'll add synthetics (stream-connect, first-byte P95, fallback rate). Alert if first-byte P95 > 150ms for 3m.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started at 1902001560. job=lowlat-canary-512, health-check=running.

nora: Docs PR opened: https://git.internal/docs/hosted/low-latency-ga. I'll add migration tips and header examples. ETA Mon EOD.

kevin: Monitoring watchlist: P50/P95 latency, 4xx/5xx, GPU util, KV-cache-hit, fallbacks.invoked. Also add metric for tool-throttle events.

jules: Client guidance: use shorter timeouts, honor X-Tool-Rate-Limit headers, exponential backoff + jitter for 429/503. We'll put sample code in SDKs.

elena: Thanks all. Legal confirmed banner language (no latency SLA). Support templates and docs need merge by Mon to hit GA. I'll post final GA announcement here once scheduled. :tada:
